scope: Seven actual PostgreSQL lock schedules against finite direct source operations; no installed acquisition or capacity claim.

Independent native byte oracle verifies all16 rows, sequence17, original producer input and acceptance receipt in every case. No socket event is admitted by this fixture.

Template, original source-pass database and original result file remain equal to pre-run observations. All owned containers stopped, actual drivers/writers joined, compiler lock released, and unrelated projections unchanged.

review: Root full changed fixture/callers/diff review plus independent read-only AI source review; root hash-checked12 build and57 engine payloads and rechecked all seven native/ledger/barrier outcomes. Shared lock helper preserves prior AST body; no product abstraction or SQL migration changed.
